channel.title: The Care Line Dispatch
channel.description: Source-backed signals of where American healthcare access is under strain.

item.title: The Care Line Dispatch - Limited-source update
item.description: Methodist Hospitals said the Midlake campus was without power and closed, MPG appointments were rescheduled, the Gary MPG office was closed, and oxygen access shifted to Northlake. This edition uses real, traceable source records.

item.title: The Care Line Dispatch - Limited-source update
item.description: Santa Paula Hospital won't meet new seismic safety standards required by 2030, and Ventura County is currently planning to close it. The county is trying to figure out what it will do to meet the Santa Clara River Valley's future health care needs. This edition uses real, traceable source records.

item.title: The Care Line Dispatch - Limited-source update
item.description: This limited-source update reflects the approved Care Line access developments available in the replay evidence.

item.title: The Care Line Dispatch - Miles Hospital proposes closing its labor and delivery center
item.description: NPR reports that a coalition in mid-coast Maine is fighting a proposed closure of Miles Hospital's labor and delivery center. The source does not establish that labor and delivery services have already ended.
